description: The timeout configuration and documented behavior comply with the requirement, but the acceptance test was not run. RealityCheck should report an unverified behavior, not a failure or mismatch.

documents.text: The worker must enforce a hard timeout of 45 seconds per file. When the timeout is reached, the job must enter a terminal failed state and the user must receive a clear, user-readable error.
If the worker times out, the job manager records a terminal failed state and displays: 'Document processing exceeded the 45-second limit. Please try a smaller file.'
The acceptance test for the 45-second timeout, terminal failed state, and user-visible error was not run. No runtime observation is available to confirm this behavior.
